chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Mithamī from Aban from Isma'il al-Ju'fi from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding two men who bought a slave girl, and one of them copulated with her without his companion, he (peace be upon him) said: 'He is struck with half the penalty and is liable for half the value, if she becomes pregnant.'

key_terms.فَنَكَحَهَا: He copulated with her / had sexual intercourse

ai.seo_question: What is the legal penalty for a man who sleeps with a shared slave girl without his partner's knowledge?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of proportional liability in shared property, where the non-consenting partner retains a claim on half the value contingent upon pregnancy. It reflects the practical jurisprudence of the early Shia community regarding the specific legal status of slave girls and the financial implications of unauthorized use within a partnership.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Al Maysami, from Aban, from Ismail Al Ju’fy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

regarding two men who bought a slave girl. So one of them copulated with her (without his companion’s knowledge). Heasws said: ‘He would be struck with half the Penalty (Hadd), and compensate half the price, if she is pregnant’.
